headline: US Critical Minerals Strategy Struggles to Reduce Reliance on China
summary: U.S. government efforts to build alternative critical mineral supply chains have yet to diminish China's dominance in the sector ahead of talks between President Trump and President Xi.
why: China controls the majority of global processing capacity for rare earths and critical minerals vital for electric vehicles, defense systems, and electronics.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Persistent reliance on Chinese mineral processing exposes U.S. tech and automotive supply chains to trade disruption.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Supply chain vulnerabilities in critical minerals remain a major focus for investors ahead of U.S.-China bilateral talks.
